name: tg-messenger
description: Telegram inside Claude Code: /tg opens a pane driven by the tg-messenger CLI.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Saved tg-messenger profile (session name) to use, e.g. default. Optional — when empty, the mod picks the single valid saved profile at boot (several valid profiles still require this to be set).

dialog.title: Dialog
dialog.description: Dialog the pane reads and writes: numeric Telegram dialog id (negative for groups) or @username (resolved once via the cached dialog list).
